plugins.name: Flight
plugins.tagline: AI rough cuts for Premiere Pro
about: Flight reads your sequence, transcribes it on this Mac and lets Claude decide the cuts. It works on a copy, so the original sequence stays as it was.
Review the cuts in grey, then apply them. Every track stays in sync.
features: Clean: removes pauses, flubs and repeats
Shorts: finds the best moments and builds 9:16 sequences
Restructure: new order with a hook first
Captions, music from Epidemic Sound and a music remover for game footage
Learns your style from your ratings and notes
plugins.includes: Includes Bill's caption editor as a tab.

requirements.for: Runs on the team's Claude plan
Music search and tracks cut to length

plugins.name: Bill
plugins.tagline: Animated, translated captions for Premiere Pro
about: Bill listens to your sequence on this Mac and times every word. It places animated captions on the timeline, and they follow when you move clips.
Start from the audio, an SRT or a transcript. Then translate the captions, on this Mac or with Claude.
features: Fast or Most accurate transcription, offline on this Mac
Add a script and Bill checks the words against it
Translated captions: on this Mac, or with Claude for better wording
A words list per client, so names come out right
Timing tool: drag words onto the audio
Style presets for fonts, colours, boxes and animation
Export as .txt or .srt

requirements.for: Translating with Claude on the team's plan

plugins.name: Honk
about: Honk lays out every sound in your sequence on a map. Left to right is how clear a sound should be, up and down is how loud.
Move a sound and Honk sets levels, EQ and ducking for everything around it.
features: Suggest places every sound by role and normalises to −14 LUFS
Automatic ducking and EQ carving under dialogue
Groups of clips that act as one sound
Master step: export, master in LANDR, import and compare
Works in Premiere Pro and After Effects

plugins.name: Gease
plugins.tagline: Text animation and easing for After Effects
about: Gease builds text animations on text layers with two markers, IN and OUT. Drag a marker to move or stretch the animation. No keyframes to shuffle.
For any layer with keyframes, Gease shapes the ease: bezier, spring or bounce, with exact overshoot.
features: Split by character, word or line with stagger
Curve editor with Apple, Material 3 and spring easings
Graph: one long ease across many keyframes
Masks, gradients and shimmer
29 presets, plus your own

plugins.name: Anser
about: Anser draws each platform's UI over your frame, so captions and logos stay clear of buttons and text.
Pick several platforms and Anser shows the area that is safe on all of them.
features: TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, Facebook, Threads, X, Bluesky and LinkedIn
Organic and ad safe zones
Superoverlay: the shared safe area in comp pixels
Updates itself from the panel too
